items.title: A.J. Brown: Expected to travel with team to Munich
items.text:
Brown (knee) is trending toward traveling with the Patriots for their trip to Munich, where the team will face the Lions this coming weekend, according to Mark Daniels of MassLive.com.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Cam Skattebo: Looks ready to go for Week 10
items.text:
Giants head coach John Harbaugh said that Skattebo (hamstring) should be "full go" for Thursday's game against the Commanders, Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News reports.

items.title: Deshaun Watson: On track to start Week 10
items.text:

items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson: Team awaits RB's MRI results
items.text:
Coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that the Patriots are awaiting MRI results on Stevenson's knee, Mark Daniels of MassLive.com reports.

items.title: J.J. McCarthy: Likely to play Thursday, despite hip pointer
items.text:
Giants head coach John Harbaugh said that McCarthy is managing a hip pointer but is expected to play Thursday against the Commanders, Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News reports. "It does look like he's gonna play," Harbaugh said. "I feel fairly good about it."
